subject: Post-demo: Protonix trial environment & mutual action plan
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@protonix.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: Protonix trial environment & mutual action plan

Hi Taylor — great conversation today, thanks for the time. This thread is a short recap and a proposed mutual action plan so we can get your trial running next week.

Recap (what we heard)
- Goal: validate Redwood for live semantic search and summarization workloads on a 500k doc corpus; target latency 350ms p95 for short queries, and embedding throughput ~100 reqs/s.
- Success criteria: accuracy parity within 8% of your current baseline on the dev eval set; p95 latency below 400ms during 50RPS synthetic load; cost estimate within 20% of your forecast.

Environment options (we discussed pros/cons)
1) Hosted trial (fastest): Redwood hosted sandbox, no infra work from Protonix, limited VPC controls, recommended for feature validation and speed-to-first-result.
2) Dedicated sandbox (recommended if you want predictable perf): reserved node pool in us-west with dedicated GPUs; minor network setup and allowed IPs.
3) VPC/private deployment (for data governance): customer VPC peering or private deployment — longer lead time (2–3 weeks) and procurement requirements.

Recommended approach
- Start with Hosted trial for the first 5 business days to run eval prompts and confirm model selection. If perf variability appears, move to Dedicated sandbox for the stability window (we can flip with minimal config changes).

Proposed immediate next steps (owners + timing)
- Protonix: confirm which datasets (S3 paths) and provide dev eval set by EOD Wednesday — owner: Taylor / Asha.
- Redwood (Ben): provision hosted sandbox + baseline run and share initial metrics within 48 hours of dataset access. Attach: trial matrix (attached).
- Redwood (Marissa): coordinate any procurement PO requests and send standard PO instructions if you opt for Dedicated.
- Redwood (Soogin) [sic]: SRE intake for VPC option if chosen (we'll need CIDR / peering details).

I've attached a trial matrix that maps success criteria to who owns which step and expected dates. Please reply with which environment you'd like to start with (Hosted / Dedicated / VPC) and we will schedule provisioning.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
https://redwood.ai

Attachments: protonix-trial-matrix.xlsx, redwood-sandbox-ops.pdf
From: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@protonix.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Rao <asha@protonix.ai>, Procurement Team <procure@protonix.ai>
Date: 2026-10-29T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Protonix trial environment & mutual action plan

Thanks Vivek — this is clear and helpful. Quick answers:
- We'll start with Hosted trial to get to results fast. If p95 variance is high, we'll request a switch to Dedicated.
- I will upload the dev eval set to the Protonix S3 bucket and share credentials (read-only) by Tue 10/31 EOD.
- Procurement: I'm looping in our procurement contact (procure@protonix.ai) to track PO options if we need Dedicated after the hosted run.

Open question: Do you have a soft estimate for Dedicated monthly cost for the baseline config you suggested (2xA10 nodes)? That will help procurement prioritize.

—Taylor
Taylor Nguyen
Head of ML Platforms | Protonix AI
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@protonix.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Protonix trial environment & mutual action plan

Hi Taylor — quick note on the Dedicated estimate and hosted expectations.

Dedicated estimate (ballpark)
- 2xA10 reserved capacity (us-west): ~$9,500/month (list), typically 25–30% discount for a 3-month pilot booking. Final price depends on committed throughput and autoscaling buffer.

Hosted trial expectations
- For the hosted sandbox we will: provision a tenant, add your S3 read-only access, run an initial ingest pipeline, and return a baseline report (latency, token cost, model quality) within 48 hours of ingest completion.
- We will instrument the baseline with the same eval prompts you provide; if you see large variance we'll recommend the Dedicated path.

Technical ask for S3 access
- Please create a read-only IAM role with the prefix arn:aws:iam::[ACCOUNT]:role/protonix-redwood-trial and share the role ARN. If you prefer temporary credentials, we can also accept a presigned S3 URL for the eval bundle.

I'll own the sandbox provisioning once Vivek gives the go-ahead.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-31T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Protonix hosted trial onramp — procurement & SRE heads-up

Marissa / Soojin — looped for awareness and quick alignment. Taylor confirmed hosted start; they plan to drop eval data Tue 10/31 EOD. Actions:
- Marissa: please prepare standard PO instructions and a short SOW for a potential Dedicated pilot. If procurement asks for an estimated invoice line, use the 2xA10 baseline from Ben with the 3-month discount note.
- Soojin: hold a 30-min SRE intake slot Wed 11/03 if they request VPC peering. We'll need CIDR and expected egress rules.

I'll send a calendar invite to Taylor for a kickoff once Ben confirms provisioning timeline.

Thanks — Vivek
From: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@protonix.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Rao <asha@protonix.ai>, Procurement Team <procure@protonix.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Protonix trial environment & mutual action plan

Vivek/Ben — update from our side: Asha uploaded the eval bundle to S3 this morning and shared the role ARN. Procurement flagged that they want a short PO if we move to Dedicated, but for Hosted we don't need a PO to start.

Request: please proceed with hosted provisioning when convenient. Can you confirm a 48h window for the baseline report after you pick up the data? Also, Ben — please include any quick tuning knobs (batch size / quantization suggestions) we should try during the hosted run.

If all goes well we'll aim to decide on Dedicated by 11/11.

Thanks — Taylor
